objective: Screen meaningful optimization ablations by loss versus elapsed wall time. Do not repeat an unchanged recipe merely to fill unused time or measure the remaining loss gap.
warmup: Always allow candidate KS3 to reach loss strictly below 5.0 before comparative early pruning; genuine errors and explicit user stop remain exceptions.
reference: Current best available comparable loss-versus-wall-time curve, whether MLP or KS3; update as better KS3 evidence becomes available.
cancel_rule: Once the candidate has reached loss <5.0, cancel on the first comparable observation where KS3_loss - current_best_loss >= 0.01 at comparable elapsed wall time.
better_run: Continue; improvement is not a cancellation reason.
comparability: Use the same loss definition and comparable objective/evaluation conditions. Never compare sampled or auxiliary training loss against full validation CE or compare at matched steps.
supersedes: The original fixed-MLP 0.5/10%-margin two-observation gate and unconditional repeat-until-target instruction are obsolete.
implementation_required_before_resume: Update and test the watchdog against this policy before any new GPU experiment; do not use the previous pruning gate.

implementation_details.training_reference: Latest compatible nonfuture measurement per eligible continuous run, within 15 wall seconds; choose the lowest across runs. No step alignment or interpolation.
implementation_details.full_validation_reference: Best canonical full-validation score already achieved by the candidate elapsed time; a model can retain its measured score after stopping.
implementation_details.evidence: Per-run screening policy, hashed reference snapshots, screening_state.json latch, and pruning.jsonl selected-reference evidence.
implementation_details.tests: test_ks3_screening.py: 11 CPU tests passed before launch.
